== English Reflections III comparison ==
The original Reflections III Defensive Shield lacks the Grabber icon. The rules treat this card as a Grabber. The 2023 Appendix A lists the Reflections III Shield separately from the Coruscant Effect. The E-marked full image and current D-E1 slip both show the icon. The printed stacking and cost text is unchanged.
